subject: [PATCH RFC v4 11/12] mm/gup: batch contiguous PTE-mapped large folios in follow_page_mask()

2026-07-24.patch_summary: This patch optimizes the handling of PTE-mapped large folios in the Linux kernel's memory management system. It introduces a new function, `folio_pte_batch_flags()`, which counts consecutive present PTEs that map contiguous pages of the same folio with uniform write bits. This allows for batched retrieval of contiguous runs of pages, reducing the number of page table walks required. The patch also ensures that per-PTE guarantees are maintained for the head page in a run. The optimization is particularly beneficial for large anonymous regions and has been measured to improve performance by up to 7.6 times.
